tool: myESI Unified DAST & Binary Analysis Tool

unified_findings.title: PE File Appears to be Packed or Obfuscated
unified_findings.description: The executable shows signs of packing (high entropy sections detected). This can hide malicious code or intellectual property.
unified_findings.remediation_guidance: Review the packing tool used. If this is a legitimate protector, document it. Otherwise, investigate for hidden payloads.

unified_findings.title: Suspicious API Imports Detected
unified_findings.description: The executable imports APIs commonly used in malicious activities (e.g., VirtualAlloc, WriteProcessMemory, CreateRemoteThread).
unified_findings.remediation_guidance: Investigate why these memory-manipulation APIs are needed. Verify they are not being misused for code injection.

unified_findings.title: YARA Rule Match: Malware_Family_X
unified_findings.description: The binary matches the YARA rule 'Malware_Family_X'. This indicates a known malware family, suspicious pattern, or specific packer.
unified_findings.remediation_guidance: Investigate the matched rule. If this is a known malware family or malicious pattern, isolate the file and perform deep dynamic analysis.

unified_findings.title: Binary is Not Position Independent (No PIE)
unified_findings.description: The binary is not compiled as position-independent, making it more vulnerable to memory corruption exploitation.
unified_findings.remediation_guidance: Recompile the binary with -fPIE -pie flags to enable ASLR protection.

unified_findings.title: High Entropy Section Detected: .text
unified_findings.description: Section '.text' has high entropy (7.50), indicating potential packing, compression, or obfuscation.
unified_findings.remediation_guidance: Investigate the section contents. High entropy may indicate packing or embedded encrypted data.

unified_findings.title: Stack Canary is Disabled
unified_findings.description: The binary does not have Stack Canary protection enabled, making it more vulnerable to memory corruption exploitation.
unified_findings.remediation_guidance: Enable Stack Canary during compilation (e.g., using GCC/Clang flags) to improve binary security.

unified_findings.title: PIE (Position Independent Executable) is Disabled
unified_findings.description: The binary does not have PIE (Position Independent Executable) protection enabled, making it more vulnerable to memory corruption exploitation.
unified_findings.remediation_guidance: Enable PIE (Position Independent Executable) during compilation (e.g., using GCC/Clang flags) to improve binary security.

unified_findings.title: YARA Rule Match: Suspicious_Packer
unified_findings.description: The extracted file 'test_deb_file.deb' matches the YARA rule 'Suspicious_Packer'. This indicates a known malware family, suspicious pattern, or specific packer.
unified_findings.remediation_guidance: Investigate the matched rule. If this is a known malicious pattern, isolate the package and perform deep dynamic analysis.
